Millions of people in our world are living in slavery.","explanation":"Both use the linked concepts of millions of oppressed people, lost freedom, slavery, and human dignity to characterize the struggle against totalitarianism."},{"child_excerpt":"These people look to the free world as their only hope to achieve this goal.","parent_excerpt":"Free people everywhere are horrified to witness the subjugation of their fellow human beings by the totalitarian states.","explanation":"Both assign the free world a moral relationship to people subjugated by communist or totalitarian regimes."},{"child_excerpt":"We must not use bayonets to force these prisoners to return to slavery and almost certain death at the hands of the communists.","parent_excerpt":"They are subject to the iron rule of despots who make the state supreme and who constantly violate God-given human rights.","explanation":"The child adapts C12's moralized description of totalitarian subjugation into the specific argument against forced prisoner repatriation."}]}
